requirement.note: The Section 8 example, the 180-day complaint window, and the two-year Superior Court window are all stated in the document.

status.evidence:
The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination  based
on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent
or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses.
status.note: The document presents the rule as current law, with no repeal or expiry noted.

coverage.evidence:
The rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family
dwelling, the other occupancy unit of which is occupied
by the owner as his/her residence at the time of such
rentals;
coverage.note: The owner-occupied two-family exemption fits a 2-unit figure. But the document also exempts rooms rented in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling, and exempts religious preference and housing for older persons. The card's single number does not capture these. No construction or certificate-of-occupancy cutoffs are listed.

citation.evidence:
The Division on Civil Rights enforces the New Jersey
Law Against Discrimination.
citation.note: The document names the LAD, so the citation is accurate. It gives no statutory section for the source-of-income provision.
